name: com.caitsy.audiotoolbox
description:
Editor tooling for game audio work in Unity. Modules are self-contained and cost nothing when unused.

AudioDoctor — static validation for audio pipelines. Reconciles what the middleware project declares, what the built banks contain, and what the Unity project references, then reports locatable, fixable issues. Eight rules, a diagnostics window, and JSON/Markdown reports for CI. Never modifies an asset.
